$comment: Lighthouse CI had NEVER run successfully in this repo's history — every CI run on main
has failed since 2026-02-12, all 20 of them, and this file is why it could not.
`lhci autorun` errored with 'Unable to automatically determine the location of static
site files' because no config existed and it cannot guess Vite's `dist/`.
That matters beyond a red badge: the `deploy` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml declares
`needs: [test, build, lighthouse]`, so a job that can never pass has been gating the
production deploy step. The deploy job has therefore never executed once. Production has
been shipping via the Vercel GitHub integration the whole time — a second, undeclared
path nobody wrote down. Same 'built != live' class as the unscheduled payout worker and
the misnamed ACCOUNT_DELETION_SECRET, reached from CI instead of from the dashboard.
No assertions are configured on purpose. Adding score thresholds here would convert a
reporting job into a NEW release gate, and this repo has just finished learning what an
unverified gate costs. Collect first, decide thresholds later against real numbers.
Upload target is the filesystem rather than temporary-public-storage: the latter
publishes rendered pages to a public URL, which is not something a CI default should do
on a platform handling payments and KYC documents.
